traps: HTTP 404 means 'no results' on the filtered listing route. Verified: domaine_des_lambrays&vintage=1990 -> 404 while the producer page is 200. An adapter that raise_for_status()es turns every empty search into an error; one that treats all 404s as empty cannot tell a dead slug from an empty vintage. Fix: validate slugs against /filters.xml first, then treat 404 on a known slug as zero results.

Producer slugs are not unique per domaine: christian_clerget + domaine_christian_clerget, bernard_dugat-py + dugat-py, domaine_faiveley + faiveley + joseph_faiveley, domaine_stephane_magnien + stephane_magnien, two Maume slugs. Deep search must query every slug mapped to a producer and union the results.
Courcel on BI lists only Les Grands Epenots (2008-2010) - no Grand Clos des Epenots. Without the 'clos' token BI would have supplied a false comp.

All In Bond rows seen in this sweep carry LIVETRADE; the one non-LIVETRADE row was Duty Paid. Seven LiveTrade listings of 2018 Clos des Lambrays span 1,125-1,800 (+60%) inside one merchant - merchant-best rule takes 1,125.
